category.name: Maps, geolocation and weather
category.description: Geocoding, routing, places, map tiles and weather forecasts.

entries.name: Geoapify
entries.free_tier: free tier: 3,000 credits/day (~90,000/month), no card required
entries.desc_en: Geocode, search places, and calculate routes/isochrones via REST APIs built on open geodata.

entries.name: Google Maps Platform
entries.auth_hint: key query param (OAuth2/IAM for some enterprise/Datasets APIs)
entries.free_tier: $200 free monthly usage credit across most Maps APIs
entries.desc_en: Geocode addresses, get directions/routes, places data, and static/dynamic maps via REST APIs or Google's remote MCP server.
entries.notes: Google also has a separate Code Assist MCP (mapscodeassist.googleapis.com/mcp) for docs grounding, distinct from this Maps Grounding Lite data MCP.

entries.name: HERE Location Services
entries.auth_hint: apiKey query param (OAuth2 app tokens also supported)
entries.free_tier: free tier: roughly 30,000 transactions/month on the Base/Freemium plan
entries.desc_en: Geocode, route, and search places worldwide via REST APIs and SDKs.
entries.notes: Free-tier limits and pricing vary by plan/signup date; confirm current allowance on the dashboard.

entries.name: IP2Location.io API
entries.auth_hint: Query parameter ?key=<API_KEY> (optional: keyless lookups allowed at a lower quota)
entries.free_tier: Free plan: 50,000 IP geolocation queries/month, 500 domain WHOIS and 50 hosted-domain queries/month (attribution required); keyless: 1,000 queries/day.
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent geolocate IPv4/IPv6 addresses, get ASN/ISP/proxy data, and look up domain WHOIS records.
entries.notes: Official MCP server is local (stdio via uv, env IP2LOCATION_API_KEY). Free plan returns basic fields; proxy/usage-type details need paid plans. Endpoint: GET https://api.ip2location.io/?key=...&ip=...

entries.name: IPLocate IP Intelligence API
entries.free_tier: Free plan: 1,000 requests/day forever, all data types (geolocation, VPN/proxy/Tor, ASN, company, abuse contacts), no credit card.
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent geolocate an IP address and get its ASN, ISP, company, abuse contacts and VPN/proxy/Tor/hosting flags.
entries.notes: Official MCP server is local (stdio, reads IPLOCATE_API_KEY). Endpoint: GET https://iplocate.io/api/lookup/{ip}; batch lookup available. Docs link an OpenAPI schema (not directly fetchable).

entries.name: Mapbox
entries.auth_hint: access_token query param or Bearer token
entries.free_tier: free tier: monthly free quotas per API (e.g. 50,000 map loads/month)
entries.desc_en: Geocode, route, and render maps/POI search via REST APIs, SDKs, or an official MCP server.
entries.notes: A separate official Mapbox Docs MCP server also exists for documentation Q&A.

entries.name: National Weather Service API (NWS)
entries.auth_hint: none, but requires a descriptive User-Agent header
entries.free_tier: free, no key, no rate-limit tier (fair-use)
entries.desc_en: Fetch official US government weather forecasts, alerts, and observations via a free public REST API.
entries.notes: US-only coverage; no API key needed, just a valid User-Agent identifying your app. Missing from candidate list despite being a very commonly used free weather API.

entries.name: Open-Meteo
entries.auth_hint: none for non-commercial use; API key + 'customer-' host prefix for commercial tier
entries.free_tier: free, no key for non-commercial use (fair-use limits apply)
entries.desc_en: Fetch weather forecasts, historical weather, and climate data worldwide via a free open REST API, no key required.
entries.notes: Commercial use requires an API key and the 'customer-api.open-meteo.com' host.

entries.name: OpenRouteService
entries.free_tier: free tier: ~2,000 requests/day (varies by endpoint), signup required
entries.desc_en: Calculate routes, isochrones, distance matrices, and geocoding over OpenStreetMap data via a free REST API.
entries.notes: Rate limits vary per endpoint (directions vs isochrones vs matrix); self-hosting also possible.

entries.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
entries.auth_hint: none, but must send a valid User-Agent/Referer identifying the app
entries.free_tier: free, no key; public demo server capped at 1 request/second, bulk use prohibited
entries.desc_en: Geocode and reverse-geocode addresses from OpenStreetMap data via a free public REST API.
entries.notes: Public demo instance is fair-use only (1 req/s, no bulk/systematic queries); self-host or use a commercial provider for production volume.

entries.name: OpenWeatherMap API
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1,000 calls/day (60 calls/min) on current weather/forecast
entries.desc_en: Fetch current weather, forecasts, and historical/air-quality data for any location via a REST API.
entries.notes: One Call API 3.0 has a separate 1,000 calls/day free allotment but requires adding billing details.

entries.name: Overpass API (OSM)
entries.free_tier: free, no key; public instances are fair-use/rate-limited
entries.desc_en: Run custom queries (Overpass QL) over OpenStreetMap data - POIs, roads, boundaries - via a public read-only API.
entries.notes: No official SLA; heavy queries can be throttled or time out on public servers.

entries.name: Tomorrow.io API
entries.free_tier: free tier: 500 requests/day, 3 req/sec, 1 monitored location/alert
entries.desc_en: Get hyperlocal weather forecasts, historical data, and alerts for any coordinates via REST API or an official MCP server.
entries.notes: No self-serve tier between Free and Enterprise - scaling past free requires a sales call.
